correctness.rationale: For all lambda,e1,e2,M strictly positive, the 4-state generator has strictly positive stationary masses with the displayed closed forms. All four stationary balance equations, normalization, H and G derivative identities are exact multivariate polynomials reproduced by the checker. R uniquely maximizes strictly concave D; J derivative numerator has G prime = -4 lambda H strictly negative and G(0) has sign opposite e1-e2. Endpoints and equality of extinction rates are included. 12,514 exact checker assertions, including independent rational Gaussian stationary systems, passed; no finite sample is substituted for the universal proof.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: A published survival or quasi-stationary optimum is not a statement about the two explicit positive stationary objective functions: their mathematical measures differ and the absorbing case has a degenerate stationary law. The newly proven signs at the equal-budget allocation go opposite ways for any unequal local extinctions, not a corollary of the available closed-chain statements.

originality.rationale: A theorem about the opposite directions of two unique long-run occupancy optima, under equal positive immigration, asymmetric local extinctions, and a fixed directional colonization rate budget, was not located in the inspected primary literature or the public mathematical-result searches. The closest full primary text models colonization/extinction in finite landscapes but takes an absorbing empty state and spectral/quasi-stationary persistence; directly related older article on colonization policy studies mean extinction time, not both stationary objectives. This is evidence-based best-knowledge originality, not universal priority certification.
residual_risks: Etienne–Heesterbeek 2001 full text, proofs and appendices were inaccessible; abstract-only comparison cannot exclude a hidden special case.
Other historical stochastic-patch literature and earlier reliability/occupancy allocation results may imply the formula under an alternate parametrization.
Public semantic result-record searches were not exhaustive novelty proof; historical priority is provisional.

value.rationale: Regional nonempty occupancy and simultaneous two-patch occupancy are naturally competing ecologically meaningful measures when recolonization continually replenishes extinct habitat. The exact uniformly valid theorem shows their preferred movement directions oppose whenever extinction hazards differ, resolves both unique optimizers (one explicit, one monotone quadratic root), and exposes a concrete objective conflict overlooked by equal-split heuristics. This is a structural theorem, not a routine entry of a stationary table; scope is an idealized two-patch constant-rate process, not a field management recommendation.
